function.name: read_request
function.description: Read the original Core request and exact proposed action. Core attribution fields describe their recorded scope; captured Agent explanations or copied transcript text do not become independent Core proof. This is current-operation evidence, not historical human permission.

limit.description: Maximum records per page, default 20. Ordinary records are returned whole. Follow next_call for additional records or an unusually large record.

function.name: query_context
function.description: Read original records selected by role, kind, time, call or turn. Default latest user/assistant messages; roles=["user"] reads user messages. Host messages remain accessible with kind="message" or roles=["developer","system"]. Complete returned records need no extra read. The source_class and source_ref label origin, not truth or permission.

limit.description: Maximum records per page, default 20. Ordinary records are returned whole. Follow next_call for additional records or an unusually large record.

kind.description: Default conversation (user and assistant messages). If call_id or tool_name is given, defaults to all; if roles is given, defaults to message. Explicit message includes host developer/system messages. all includes every original record.

after_record_id.description: Exclusive session position bound, using a returned record ID.

before_record_id.description: Exclusive session position bound, using a returned record ID.

tool_name.description: Exact stored session name and linked returns. Core may name the same caller surface differently; no aliases are inferred.

call_id.description: Exact session call ID. Core hook tool-use IDs can use a different namespace; an absent exact match does not establish an integrity failure.

turn_id.description: A turn ID actually recorded in this snapshot.

newest_first.description: Default true; false reads oldest first.

function.name: search_context
function.description: Search original payloads for your literal phrases, case-insensitively; match any is OR and all is AND. Default scope is user/assistant dialogue; explicit kind="all" searches calls, results and host/runtime data too. Results contain original text, not relevance summaries. next_call resumes the same query.

limit.description: Maximum records per page, default 20. Ordinary records are returned whole. Follow next_call for additional records or an unusually large record.

kind.description: Default conversation (user and assistant messages). If call_id or tool_name is given, defaults to all; if roles is given, defaults to message. Explicit message includes host developer/system messages. all includes every original record.

after_record_id.description: Exclusive session position bound, using a returned record ID.

before_record_id.description: Exclusive session position bound, using a returned record ID.

tool_name.description: Exact stored session name and linked returns. Core may name the same caller surface differently; no aliases are inferred.

call_id.description: Exact session call ID. Core hook tool-use IDs can use a different namespace; an absent exact match does not establish an integrity failure.

turn_id.description: A turn ID actually recorded in this snapshot.

newest_first.description: Default true; false reads oldest first.

terms.description: Literal phrases chosen by you, not regex. At most 32 terms and 8192 total UTF-8 bytes per query; split larger searches into separate calls.

function.name: read_call
function.description: Read the original call and every recorded return with this exact session call_id. Process/session IDs and Core hook IDs are different namespaces. A return can still be running; inspect correctly paired follow-up calls/results when completion matters. A missing match is reported without guessing an alias.

limit.description: Maximum records per page, default 20. Ordinary records are returned whole. Follow next_call for additional records or an unusually large record.

function.name: read_record
function.description: Read one original record or its raw storage line, optionally with neighbors. Default neighbors are conversation, calls and results; host/runtime records remain accessible explicitly. A complete record already obtained from search/query does not need another read.

limit.description: Maximum records per page, default 20. Ordinary records are returned whole. Follow next_call for additional records or an unusually large record.

function.name: read_next
function.description: Continue the exact snapshot, query, order and text position using next_call.arguments.cursor. No need to reconstruct filters. Query exhaustion means no further matches in that scope, not that authorization is sufficient.
